title: Change address as a holder of a passenger exemption letter
summary: Provisional licence holders with a passenger exemption letter must inform Transport for NSW of any address changes within 14 days at a Service NSW Centre.
intro:
If you're a provisional licence holder and you have an exemption letter for passenger conditions, you must inform Transport for NSW within 14 days if your address changes. You can do this at a Service NSW Centre.

Note: If the change of address affects your current exemption reason or if your employment details have changed, you’ll need to surrender your exemption letter and submit a new application.
who_can_apply: Holder of an exemption letter for passenger conditions
what_you_need: The PDF form: Application for Exemption – Peer Passenger, One Passenger or Prohibited Vehicle Condition (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre to change your address.

external_links.text: Application for Exemption – Peer Passenger, One Passenger or Prohibited Vehicle Condition – PDF

faqs.q: How quickly must I report an address change?
faqs.a: You must inform Transport for NSW within 14 days if your address changes.

faqs.q: What if my address change affects my exemption reason or employment details?
faqs.a: You will need to surrender your exemption letter and submit a new application.

faqs.q: Where can I change my address?
faqs.a: You can change your address at a Service NSW Centre.
